reports.interpretation: Positive difference means block-derived rainfall is higher. This measures disagreement, not accuracy.
reports.decomposition: Symmetric algebra: source=(Sb-Sd)*(fb+fd)/2; reference=(Sb+Sd)*(fb-fd)/2; sum equals B-D before output rounding. Not causal attribution.
reports.limitation: Same validity date does not prove identical accumulation hours, issue time or forecast lead time. Village polygons are not verified gram-panchayat boundaries.
